{"notes": "Visit 3 (left 4:15). Board: the belly chain from the start is unchanged and still reaches the tail curl at x=25-28, with the cramped bunching near x=25, y=9. The back line is long and almost complete (pale, nose to about x=23, plus a pale stub near the tail at x=27-28, y=7), but it is still NOT connected. The gap at the nose is still open, and the back line also doesn't visibly meet the tail fork. About 5.5 min left, so this is the main risk. I can't tell who placed which dominoes, so I'm judging only on what I saw and heard.

Sofia: Spoke up three times (3:30, 3:45, 4:00). She correctly diagnosed that the top line stops just short of the nose, and she's directing Jack clearly. But after 45 seconds of 'bridging now' and 'looking closely' the gap is still open in the picture. Good diagnosis and communication, but no visible execution yet. Check next visit whether the bridge actually lands, and whether she's over-analysing instead of placing.

Jack: Told to keep going on the top line, and the top line does look largely built, but I can't confirm he built it. Heard nothing from him. Follow up on whether he finished it and joined the tail end.

Omar: Not seen or heard this visit. Last seen announcing the upper tail fork. Check that it has a feed line and isn't crowding the x=25 join.

Hana: Not seen or heard this visit. Said she wanted a dry run and a join check on the lower fork. Not yet evidenced, and the tail join still looks cramped. Check whether she follows through.

Next visit: is the nose connected, does the back line reach the tail, and has a dry run happened?"}
